item.title: Saturday 4 PM Update, Oct 31
item.description:
The Saturday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 31, 2026, Halloween: Londonderry conditions through tomorrow afternoon; a federal judge throws out the President's lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal, Virginia and D.C. sue to stop the planned arch near Arlington, and a check on a viral claim about networks and a presidential address; Poland's prime minister addresses the nation and Halloween protests turn tense in Marseille; Apple passes Nvidia as the world's most valuable company and Microsoft's small computer-use model; Mistral opens the weights of its trillion-parameter model and OpenAI's new biology model for vetted researchers; an Android text message that can crash phones and a breach at Chainalysis; your X feed; a death investigation in Bow; and a bus-stop bench that made a kid jump for joy. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday 10 AM Update, Oct 31
item.description:
The Saturday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 31, 2026, Halloween: Londonderry conditions through tomorrow morning; a deadly shooting at a California Halloween store, Trump's Sunday rallies locked in, and NASA's Swift telescope nears its fall; Poland's crisis talks split the governing coalition, Iran's supreme leader threatens a swift response, Oleshky evacuees reach Ukrainian-held land, and Britain weighs a slavery apology; Google's sunlight-seeking robot planter; a near three-billion-dollar round for Kling A.I. and a UK probe of Meta's A.I. terms; Anthropic says the backdoored Claude Code extension came through Cursor's marketplace, plus the Amadeus airline breach and Cisco SD-WAN spying; your X feed; a New Hampshire mailer crackdown in the Senate race; and Karl Bushby's twenty-eight-year walk home. item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
